claims.text: Xcel announced the AI wildfire-camera program for the Texas Panhandle.
claims.statement: Xcel announced the AI wildfire-camera program for the Texas Panhandle.
claims.quote: Xcel Energy is increasing its wildfire detection and mitigation efforts in the Texas Panhandle by introducing artificial intelligence to spot fires early.
claims.scope_note: December2024 announcement establishes program geography, not each camera location or current deployment count.

claims.text: Xcel describes smoke scanning, human verification, location triangulation and notification to a 911 call center.
claims.statement: Xcel describes smoke scanning, human verification, location triangulation and notification to a 911 call center.
claims.quote: Pano AI’s system combines 360-degree high-definition cameras, AI-driven smoke detection and satellite data integration to continuously scan for smoke. When a potential fire is detected, Pano immediately verifies it through human analysts, triangulates the location and notifies the 911 call center to activate the closest fire department.
claims.scope_note: Corporate description of intended response workflow. Do not claim each alert has been measured as useful or verified on time.
